caption: The drawing depicts a handheld lantern placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The lantern has a hexagonal metal frame with glass panels on each side, and is depicted in shades of gray, black, and brown. Each glass panel is bordered and protected by crisscrossing diagonal metal strips. The top of the lantern features a conical, vented cover with small perforations and is attached to a wide, circular handle, which is positioned upright and secured with a metal fastener. Inside the lantern, a cylindrical structure, likely intended for holding a candle or light source, is visible through the glass. There is a small amount of shaded area beneath the lantern that suggests its three-dimensional form, and the word "LON VERRE" is faintly written in small text below the object.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
